_: What the Android store's signed channel offers. `node scripts/store-channel.js build` turns this
into dist/store-channel/store-channel.json — every digest measured, the whole thing signed.
Only items whose developer publishes no Android build belong here: our own engines (tunnelcore,
gst), tor and lyrebird, our own workers and data files. Aether, BPB, edgetunnel and the geo data
install straight from their developers' GitHub and need no entry.
PIN WHAT HAS BEEN TESTED. An item's `id` is its StoreCatalog id. Per item: version, released,
notes, optional minApp (the app must be at least this) and forAppsBelow (only apps older than
this, i.e. ones that ship something older). Per artifact: name, format (raw | tar.gz | zip),
extract {pathInArchive: installedName}, optional abi, and exactly one of from.github / from.url /
from.file. A raw artifact installs under its catalogue file name (e.g. libtor.so, dns_worker.js).
